# Test fixtures

| file | origin | licence |
|---|---|---|
| `irs_w9.pdf` | IRS Form W-9 (Rev. March 2024), https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw9.pdf | US Government work, public domain |
| `simple_text.pdf` | generated by the pdfwords authors (2 pages, ligatures, hyphenation) | Apache-2.0; embeds a Charis SIL subset (OFL-1.1) |
| `rot90.pdf` | generated by the pdfwords authors (`/Rotate 90`, Helvetica) | Apache-2.0 |
| `synthetic.pdf`, `synthetic.json` | `tools/make_synthetic.py` (seeded), exact ground truth | Apache-2.0 |

Third-party documents used by some tests and benchmarks (arXiv papers, camelot sample) are
**not** committed. `tools/fetch_test_pdfs.py` downloads them into `tests/data/` (git-ignored,
SHA-256 pinned). Tests that need them are skipped when they are unavailable.
